authentication_boundary.transaction: one complete C2 top-level emit, append, optional execute and rollback operation
authentication_boundary.family_evidence: catalog header, profile/build identity, directory shape and directory CRC are authenticated once at the first slice of each transaction
per_slice_evidence: record identity, ABI, VMA, length and entry offset
authentication_boundary.generation_binding: the selected session family and its nonzero generation must match at begin and every slice; a family change during a transaction fails closed
invalidation: attempted family or generation switch while active

security_argument.invariant: Within one session generation, family catalog evidence is immutable and identity-bound. Repeating its validation for every slice within one transaction adds no new evidence.
security_argument.fresh_data_rule: Record validation, payload CRC and wiping remain per slice because each slice carries fresh executable data.
security_argument.between_transactions: Every transaction starts unauthenticated; its first slice reruns full catalog authentication even when the generation is unchanged.
security_argument.generation_change: A new generation cannot inherit transaction trust and must authenticate the catalog again before any payload executes.

required_negative_cases: payload mutation between two transactions in the same generation is rejected by the remaining per-slice CRC
catalog/profile mutation after a generation change is rejected by fresh authentication
family or generation switch while a transaction is active is rejected and latches fail-closed
second slice in one transaction executes with one catalog proof but its own record and payload proof
first_red_rule: Any failed source, semantic, mutation, capacity, placement or structure gate stops before a product link. Link 30 remains the candidate pin.
